description: Waves Home Appliances Limited (formerly Samin Textiles Limited) is a public limited company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange that manufactures, assembles and wholesales domestic consumer appliances and other light engineering products. It is a subsidiary of Waves Corporation Limited (formerly Waves Singer Pakistan Limited). The Waves appliance business itself dates from 1971, when the group introduced Pakistan's first deep freezer in Lahore; refrigerators followed in 1976, split air conditioners in 2002 and washing machines in 2004.
headOffice: 9 KM Multan Road, Hanjarwal, Lahore, Pakistan
